rule: Amendment 7 (t217u): exclude, don't map. Existing data-v9 rows whose kind matches a listed kind or prefix for a new head are EXCLUDED for that head: loss weight 0 for that head (training) and left out of that head's scoring (C1-C3, V2). They are not relabelled; their eight new-head gold stays 0 in the file. All other existing rows are 0 on all eight new heads. The mapped (kind -> 1) list is empty.
applies_to: existing data-v9 rows only (new rows carry slot-spec gold for every head)
